extracted.name: VashBake Smothered pork chops
extracted.description: As a personal care assistant sometimes the company may have limited resources so a disable client asked for this recipe and here goes nothing.❤️👩‍🍳
instruction_lines: In a shallow pan place washed and clean pork chops
Begin by placing one single porkchop in bowl. Drop 1 egg in with porkchop and flour. Use clean hand to batter pork chop
In a pan pour vegetable oil in and begin to place on medium heat. Put one porkchop in at time frying until golden brown
After reaching a golden brown finish transfer porkchops to an additional shallow pan. Adding cornstarch to the roux and milk to thicken the gravy
After creating the gravy cover with aluminum foil and allow to thicken
Leave oven on 350° allow to simmer the longer the smothered porkchops simmer the more tender.
